status: Design prerequisite; a conservative complete-stack implementation was subsequently added in status-thread-drain-20261008. End-to-end runtime integration remains open.
goal: Bootstrap exact STATUS revision observation after all five permanent one-byte entry gates are active, without assuming older unobserved calls finished.

phases.name: Prepare
requirements: No STATUS lease may exist. Fully construct immutable original trampolines and typed wrappers, RX protection, cache flush and unwind registration before gate publication.
Metadata storage, locks, wrapper bindings, router and generated code have process lifetime. Initialize observation before any wrapper can execute; keep a separate bootstrap gate closed.
Validate the complete known writer closure, imports and dynamic condition-variable bindings under the supported native/OS contract.

phases.name: Publish
requirements: Install all five entry gates with exact-byte ownership and cache flush, leaving every other original byte intact.
A partial installation or failed flush/protection restore cannot be used for baseline adoption. Resident routing must continue to forward already patched entries even when confidence is lost.
Only calls entering after gates are visible are known to have BeforeEntry; old PCs in the original body or helper stack remain unobserved.

phases.name: Identify old threads
requirements: After complete gate publication, enumerate all process threads and retain real handles with stable lifetime identity. Thread ID reuse alone cannot identify the same thread.
An exiting retained thread is drained; an unreadable, unsuspendable, truncated or corrupt stack is unresolved.

A new thread created after complete gate publication can only become a supported writer through a tracked entry; this relies on supported native control flow, not arbitrary SetThreadContext or jumps into the middle of a function.

phases.name: Drain
requirements: Capture each pre-existing remote thread's full active RSP..StackBase span and full context under suspension, then resume before inspection. Storage is preallocated and touched. Work is byte-bounded; paging and kernel scheduling prevent a hard elapsed-time bound. Capture the current game thread without suspending itself.

Before declaring an old thread drained, require that neither RIP nor any aligned word in the complete active stack lies in any original writer body. The verified normal closure retains root return slots. Incidental data matches defer admission. Missing, truncated, unreadable or oversized captures never count as clean. Static unwind metadata is an optional way to investigate false positives; it is not used by this negative full-span proof.

Do not hold a metadata lock across SuspendThread, invoke arbitrary function-table callbacks, initialize libraries, acquire loader locks or allocate while another thread is suspended. Resume every successfully suspended thread on every path.
If an older writer remains, resume that thread and retry later; do not rewrite its PC, mint a synthetic Before ticket, reset the ledger or suppress its native call.

The five normal writer closures have no engine fiber yield, under the recorded external API assumptions. Exceptional/custom callback paths need independent treatment and cannot silently inherit this proof.

phases.name: Adopt
requirements: All retained pre-existing threads must be proved drained; every gate, copied original and required code/import contract remains intact.

Under metadata serialization require no tracked native writer active; then validate the pool/free-list/refcount/backlink, actor generation, role, exact fields and revision identity before acquisition.

Keep all subsequent native entry/exit observations active on every thread, including menus, off-current actors and host expiry. Before and after every manual field mutation, maintain the same ownership rules.
Native abnormal completion, missing exit, invalid index, lost hook, overflow or unknown acknowledgement remains uncertainty, never permission to restore stale values.

rejectedShortcuts: A fixed sleep or frame count
Current RIP outside a writer without proving the complete active stack contains no retained root continuation
An empty ledger active count immediately after installation
Snapshotting only pointer/refcount/backlink and equal scalar bits
Treating resource phase0/1 as completed because its scheduler callback returned
runtimeStatus: Separate Router, original trampolines, typed Observer, complete-stack Drain and field journal prerequisites now exist. Their actual game installation, Actor provider and IPC integration remain open. This design document does not assert a completed bootstrap.
